title: Question / information / answer register — updates from this round

rows.question: Which price feed will supply market prices?
rows.information_had: Nothing. No official source publishes betting prices.
rows.information_added_this_round: The price-snapshot store now exists and defines exactly what a feed must supply (open, close, timestamp, source, per market selection).
rows.answer_now: STILL OPEN — the feed choice is an owner decision (suggestion S-01, path A recommended).
rows.still_missing: A licensed/account price feed. Until then every price cell stays blank or flagged UNVERIFIED.
rows.blocks: CLV gate G-11, live staking, verified ROI.

rows.question: Do we record the price at origination, at close, or both?
rows.information_added_this_round: The store records both: our_line at our_originated_at, plus market_open and market_close cells.
rows.answer_now: ANSWERED — both, per the store schema (data/prices/price_snapshots.csv).
rows.still_missing: Nothing structural; timestamps fill when the feed does.

rows.question: What is the official source for final scores?
rows.information_had: A probe found no server-rendered results table on nfl.com/scores.
rows.information_added_this_round: The weekly schedule pages DO print every final score (nfl.com/schedules/2026/by-week/week-N). 137 games transcribed and verified against standings arithmetic.
rows.answer_now: ANSWERED — the NFL.com weekly schedule pages; the verified results feed is built on them.
rows.still_missing: Box scores (not needed for side/total/ML grading).

rows.question: Which markets do we originate first: side, total, or moneyline?
rows.information_added_this_round: Owner directive: side first, then total, then moneyline — enforced by the builder.

rows.question: What happens to a strategy that passes gates on paper but loses live?
rows.information_had: Nothing — the demotion threshold was undefined (blocked G-13).
rows.information_added_this_round: Demotion gate D1-D5 defined with concrete thresholds (data/gates_v2.json).
rows.answer_now: ANSWERED — automatic demotion to paper on D1-D4; re-promotion only via D5.
rows.still_missing: Nothing structural; thresholds can be re-tuned by recorded decision.

rows.question: Minimum sample, skill test, multiple-testing correction?
rows.information_added_this_round: The signal block names the tests (CLV t-test, binomial vs break-even) and the demotion windows (50-bet trailing, 30-bet minimum).
rows.answer_now: PARTLY — the tests are named in the signal block and gates_v2; the promotion minimums are still owner-settable.
rows.still_missing: The owner's chosen minimum-bet count and correction method for promotion (Q-07/Q-09).

verification.note: Answers cite the artefact that settles them; open items say so.
